name: Thermometer
description: Guidelines for traveling with thermometer in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Digital and medical thermometers are allowed in carry-on. Mercury thermometers are restricted to carry-on (maximum one per person, in a protective case).

checkedBag.reason: Mercury thermometers are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Digital thermometers are allowed.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring thermometer on a plane?

travelTips: Digital and medical thermometers are allowed in carry-on. Mercury thermometers are restricted to carry-on (maximum one per person, in a protective case).

faq.question: Is thermometer allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Thermometer is allowed in carry-on luggage. Digital and medical thermometers are allowed in carry-on. Mercury thermometers are restricted to carry-on (maximum one per person, in a protective case).

faq.question: Can you pack thermometer in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Thermometer is not allowed in checked bags. Mercury thermometers are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Digital thermometers are allowed.
